purpose: Exercise the production Win64 FLTK archive-open and extract path under Wine with a UTF-8 member name.
command: xvfb-run -a python3 <automation>: launch boltpack-gui.exe --shell-extract unicode.blt, accept the Wine Browse for Folder dialog's selected Desktop with Return, compare extracted bytes, dismiss completion, and close with Ctrl+Q
scope_limit: This is an interactive Win64 FLTK extraction under Wine, not native Windows qualification. It does not cover archive creation, metadata restoration, cancellation, replacement preservation, or native NTFS/FAT behavior.
